sentences.text: Date of Decision: 22.05.2023 Deepak Kumar ..... Petitioner  Versus State of Punjab .......Respondent CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH BHARDWAJ
Present: Mr. Sanjeev Kumar, Advocate, for the petitioner.

This is second petition filed by the petitioner for grant of regular bail to him in a case FIR No.16,
dated 28.01.2022, registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, at Police Station Shahpurkandi,
Pathankot.

The petitioner on the earlier occasion filed petition for grant of regular bail, which came up for hearing on 16.02.2023 and the following order was passed:-
"After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he does not want to press this petition at this stage.
Allowed to do so.
Dismissed as not pressed at this stage."
The petitioner has again approached this Court by way of filing the second petition for grant of bail.
This Court does not find any change in circumstances which may be considered for the grant of bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed.
